page.overview:
Who is 73?

73 was the designation of an Imperial stormtrooper stationed on the spaceport of the planet Thyferra. During the Bacta War in 7 ABY, a short firefight ensued on the spaceport when another stormtrooper tried to arrest Rogue Squadron pilot Corran Horn, who was under disguise. 73 fell from an elevated walkway along with Horn during the course of the skirmish.
